headline: Southwestern (Texas) paces the SAA behind a stingy defense
dek: Southwestern (Texas) closed the season with sixteen wins, more than any other program in the conference, while conceding just twelve goals. Only two opponents beat Southwestern (Texas), which added two draws and 37 goals scored to finish unbeaten in conference play.
